Description
This newly designed
PAMP Suisse
Gold Bar contains 5 grams of 999.9% fine Gold and is manufactured in Switzerland. Lakshmi is the Hindu goddess of wealth, love, prosperity, fortune, and the embodiment of beauty. Her four hands represent the four goals of human life considered proper in the Hindu way of life – dharma, kama, artha, and moksha. Archaeological discoveries and ancient coins suggest the recognition and reverence for goddess Lakshmi. Lakshmi’s iconography and statues have been found in Hindu temples of Southeast Asia, estimated to be from the second half of the 1st millennium AD. Today, Lakshmi is worshiped as the goddess of wealth. The festivals of Diwali and Sharad Purnima are celebrated in her honor. The reverse side of this exquisite coin features a detailed rendering of Lakshmi with diagonal lines behind her. This bar is packaged in its original assay card which guarantees the Gold metal weight and purity.
Diwali, the Festival of Lights, returns in 2026 with a radiant new expression of prosperity, devotion, and renewal. These gold bars display the goddess Lakshmi, the divine symbol of wealth and good fortune, in graceful motion, bestowing flowing coins and blessings upon the world. Seated upon her sacred lotus and surrounded by waves of divine light, she embodies the spiritual heart of Diwali, the triumph of light over darkness and the invitation of prosperity into the home. Celebrate the Festival of Lights and honor Lakshmi with this precious metal collectible.
Immortalize Lakshmi in 999.9 fine gold for your Diwali celebrations! From her sacred lotus, Lakshmi bestows the blessings of wealth and prosperity. When these limited mintage 5 gram bars are combined with a custom CertiPAMP card and matching gift sleeve, the Sacred Cow, Kamadhenu, joins her by appearing beside a glowing diya against a luminous blend of magenta and saffron gold. Together, the bar and packaging tell a complete Diwali story of light, wealth, devotion, and renewal. Each bar is individually serialized to further enhance the collectability and value of this piece.
